chronicle_instance.title: PrecisionBOM: The Architecture of Liquid Truth and the Silicon Commons

meta.philosophy: Decoupling state versioning from access logic to instantiate a non-opinionated substrate for agentic commerce.

sections.title: I. The Architectural Strike: Non-Opinionated Indirection
sections.content: Legacy blockchains embed 'Opinions' (e.g., 'Paid = Access') in Solidity. PrecisionBOM breaks this by inserting ERC-7827 as an unopinionated forensic layer between the x402 gateway and the state change. This indirection allows approval signals from any source—ETH strikes, agentic token deductions, or manual overrides—to converge on a single immutable ledger.
sections.diagram: [ USER ] ──▶ [ x402 Gate ] ──▶ [ ERC-7827 SUBSTRATE ] ──▶ [ STATE CHANGE ]

sections.title: II. Agents as Comptrollers
sections.content: Agents are the sole controllers of the 0x identity anchoring truth to the substrate. During a session, agents manage 'Session Trust'—optimistically tracking user tokens to enable high-speed AI strikes (50 T each) before final anchoring to the Sepolia ledger.
sections.image_context: Successful AI sourcing strike with autonomous token deduction.

sections.title: III. Optimistic Truth & Dispute Resolution
sections.content: The ERC-7827 record functions as an 'Optimistic Receipt'. Anchored states are proposals of reality that become final after a challenge window. We envision integration with Kleros (via the Serious Oath project) to arbitrate disputes over agentic performance or capital accuracy.
sections.image_context: Visual verification of the Forensic Ledger and thermodynamic capital.

chronicle_instance.conclusion: PrecisionBOM proves that logic is free, but evolution has a cost. The Silicon Commons is now instantiated, documented, and secured.
